log_level.description: Global logging level. Controls verbosity of messages logged to stderr/syslog.

rsl_ip.description: IP address used for RSL (Radio Signalling Link) connections to the BSC.

bts_type.description: Type of BTS hardware or emulation backend (e.g., sysmobts, sysmoUsim, osmo-bts-trx).

trx_nr.description: Transceiver instance number (0-indexed). Used when multiple TRX units exist.

ts_nr.description: List of timeslot numbers to configure. Each timeslot can be individually tuned.

ts0_arfcn.description: Absolute RF channel number (ARFCN) for timeslot 0.

ts0_bsic.description: Base Station Identity Code (BSIC) for timeslot 0 (6-bit value).

pcu_sock_path.description: Unix domain socket path for local management (e.g., by osmo-bsc or CLI tools).

local_ip.description: Local IP address to bind PCU socket (for remote management or proxy).

osmo_bsc_ip.description: IP address of the Osmocom BSC (e.g., osmo-bsc) to connect for RSL and NSVC.

osmo_bsc_port.description: Port number of the BSC to connect (default 4242 for IPA/IP over IP).

max_pdch_alloc.description: Maximum number of PDCHs that may be dynamically allocated per cell.
